quality_log.issue: CSV header 'Burning rate; mm' gives a length unit for a burning-rate constant.
quality_log.evidence: NTRS-20150023456 p. 26 header: 'Burning rate, mm2 /s' and p. 25 definition (linear fit of diameter squared versus time).

quality_log.issue: CSV composition headers read 'O', 'N', 'CO', 'He' (subscripts lost in encoding).
quality_log.action: Interpreted as O2, N2, CO2, He mole fractions.
quality_log.evidence: NTRS-20150023456 p. 26 table header 'O2 N2 CO2 He'.

quality_log.issue: CSV headers '?-g Burn Length', '?-g Spread Length' (the micro sign was lost in encoding).
quality_log.action: Interpreted as microgravity (µ-g) burn and spread length.
quality_log.evidence: Internal: paired with '1-g Burn Length' columns in the same table.

quality_log.issue: Sample length 40.6 cm and width 94 cm appear swapped relative to SAFFIRE-III (length 94 cm, width 40.6 cm) for the same SIBAL sample geometry.
quality_log.action: Flagged, not corrected (no primary source checked).
quality_log.evidence: Internal inconsistency between PSI-98 and PSI-100 tables.

quality_log.issue: PSI record lists dates 03-02-2001 to 02-28-2008 and platform ISS, identical to SAME (PSI-102), while Saffire flew on Cygnus in 2016.
quality_log.action: Flagged; IGNIS uses the Cygnus platform for Saffire tables.
quality_log.evidence: Internal inconsistency between PSI-98, PSI-99 (Cygnus) and PSI-102 records.

quality_log.issue: First author listed as 'Oslon, Sandra. L.' in NTRS metadata; the PDF reads 'S.L. Olson'.
quality_log.action: Display name taken from the PDF title page.

quality_log.issue: Caption states average 0g margin -2.6% and average Martian margin '2.7%'; Table I values give means of -1.38% (0g) and -2.72% (Martian).
quality_log.action: IGNIS uses Table I values (recomputed and verified with Eq. 1); the caption averages are not used.
quality_log.evidence: NTRS-20130010991 p. 6 (Table I) and p. 7 (Fig. 6 caption).
